create_boxlist_from_numpy: create a BoxList from a numpy array of bounding box coordinates in ymin xmin ymax xmax format
get_box_coordinates: get the corner coordinates of all boxes as separate y_min, x_min, y_max, x_max numpy arrays
add_field_to_boxlist: add a custom field like classification scores to a BoxList with matching dimensions
get_field_from_boxlist: get data from a specified field in the BoxList including boxes or extra fields
check_boxlist_fields: check if a field exists in the BoxList and list all extra fields added to it
